name: Banh mi cay
summary: Bánh mì cay is a very hot little pate sandwich, about two fingertips wide, with a crisp crust. Chí chương, the chili sauce, supplies the heat.
origin: Hai Phong. The 23 December 2012 city portal and the 24 July 2023 tourism portal both describe it.
texture: The 23 December 2012 account calls the crust crisp and hot. Ban Tuyên giáo và Dân vận Thành ủy Hải Phòng also calls the piece a small crisp stick, and does not print a date.
taste: The 2012 account calls it very hot, with fragrant pate, and says the seller may add fat and seasoning after the charcoal. The 2023 tourism portal calls chí chương the local chili sauce. Ban Tuyên giáo và Dân vận Thành ủy Hải Phòng uses the same name for the sauce.
howToEat: Eat it to carry. Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng pairs it with trà cúc and calls it something to take home. The 2012 account also puts it at the end of the working day in winter.
Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng prints 2,500 đồng a piece on 24 July 2023. The city portal prints 5,000–7,000 đồng on 23 December 2012. Both stay. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: 23 December 2012: ngã ba Khánh Nạp on Hàng Kênh, Lê Lợi, and Đinh Tiên Hoàng. 24 July 2023: Lê Lợi, Minh Khai, and Phan Bội Châu. A shop name is not the address. The hour is Check on arrival.
priceBand: Cổng du lịch Hải Phòng prints 2,500 đồng a piece on 24 July 2023. Cổng thông tin điện tử thành phố Hải Phòng prints 5,000–7,000 đồng on 23 December 2012.
seoTitle: Banh mi cay — Hai Phong’s small hot sandwich
seoDescription: A very hot little pate sandwich with a crisp crust and chí chương chili sauce.
